title: Unlock, raise and pivot a monitor to portrait beside a box
instruction: Raise the monitor screen 130 mm from its lowest position and rotate it 90 degrees to portrait, leaving tilt unchanged (6 mm and 3 degree tolerances). Three identical unmarked buttons each release one spring-locked axis while held. Do not touch the adjacent box, let the screen touch furniture, force a lock or end stop, or tip or slide the stand. Release the stand and all buttons; keep the screen still within tolerance with both hands off for the final 20 seconds.
context: Adjusting shared and accessible workstations requires releasing the correct locks, supporting a heavy screen around obstacles, relocking it and leaving it stable.
setup: Coordinates are world metres, +Z up; one fixed layout, no jitter. Standard1.10x1.30x0.06m laminate table centred(0.36,0,0.7175), top0.7475. Custom steel-like monitor stand trainer:280x220x16mm foot,50x70x420mm column, 0-145mm lift,-5..21deg tilt,0..90deg pivot; total moving/fixed stand mass7.192kg. Black plastic-like490x290x47mm screen,3.1kg including its pivot assembly. Initial fixture root(0.36,0,0.7475),yaw90deg, lowest landscape/untilted; screen centre(0.36,0.1205,0.9525). Three identical unmarked14mm plastic button caps,35mm spacing,6.5mm stroke, linked to three steel spring index pins. Fixed grey120x100x200mm box centred(0.68,0.10,0.8475), treated as a rigid obstacle. Two20x20x30cm steel-like arm pedestals centred(0,+/-0.305,0.8975); genuine six-joint YAM bases(0,+/-0.305,1.05), parallel grippers open in READY. Standard station metal camera mount:110x110x16mm foot,24mm-diameter928mm vertical mast,18mm-diameter54mm short arm and50x42x22mm camera housing; one overhead and two wrist RGB cameras. Static floor. Exact initial poses, all primitive sizes/masses/friction and station parts are in setup-inventory.json, fixture.json and the pinned SDK.
scoring: Let h be lift in mm,p native pivot in degrees,t tilt from start. Full1.0 requires |h-130|<6,|p-90|<3,|t|<3, no robot/stand contact, and the final continuous20s in these bounds with height speed<20mm/s and angular speeds<0.02rad/s. Otherwise each changed-axis stage is1 within its goal tolerance,0 within tolerance of its start0,else clip(1-|value-goal|/|goal|,0,1). Partial=min(0.9,0.6*mean(height_stage,pivot_stage)*(1 if hands off else0.5)+0.3*min(final qualifying hold,20)/20),rounded4decimals; hold credit is0 unless all pose tolerances pass and hands are off. Any screen/furniture contact, robot/box contact, forced lock/stop, unsupported foot reaction lasting20ms, wrist>80N for100ms, or final|tilt|>=3deg vetoes all credit. Invalid/missing measurements score0. numeric_score.py and telemetry_math.py implement all cases.
reset_notes: Return to lowest landscape/untilted with all pins seated; restore the fixed layout. The episode reset clears fixture joints/velocities/efforts before settling.
fidelity: Isaac Lab-Arena/PhysX with genuine bimanual YAM. Rigid primitive stand and panel; spring index pins and button linkages, estimated masses/friction. Base and side box are fixed; continuous measured foot reactions veto unsupported lift/slide/twist. No monitor cables, material deformation or pin fracture; geometric lock/stop violations veto credit. Two physical 30cm arm pedestals; CPU physics at240Hz, control20Hz.
scores: Dream-1 (dreamlabs/dream-1-beta):0.0 after1428actions; scripted genuine-YAM Arena/PhysX demo:1.0 after1204actions. One fixed layout; no model-success or robustness claim.
